text:
ana: quick one — where do I find NimbusPay's Grafana dashboards in the private stack? Customer asked if we can embed a subset of panels into their portal and they also want a sanity check on OTLP/Prom forwarding QoS.

matt: @ana — dashboards live under the org folder but we have a cust-specific folder: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/nimbuspay/nimbuspay-overview (you need SSO role: customer-obsv-view). To embed panels the iframe endpoint is allowed but we only allow allowlisted origins.

ana: can you paste the iframe link pattern? customer is stuck on CSP errors.

matt: iframe pattern: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d-solo/<dashboard-uid>/<panel-slug>?orgId=1&panelId=<id>&kiosk=tv
Make sure to add their host to the dashboard allowlist in the console -> Observability -> Embeds.

zola: on the OTLP / Prom side — we saw sporadic drops for NimbusPay last week. Check remote_write reliability and the prom scrape failures for the job `customer_nimbuspay_node`. Prom config snippet we recommend for remote_write backoff: 

```
remote_write:
  - url: "https://prom-remote.redwood.internal/api/v1/write?tenant=nimbuspay"
    basic_auth:
      username: "__token__"
      password: "<token>"
    send_exemplars: true
    queue_config:
      max_shards: 200
      max_samples_per_send: 1000
    retry_on_http_429: true
```

zola: if you see 429s the first fix is to throttle scrape frequency or enable local scrape federation. Also confirm that promtail is forwarding logs to Loki with correct tenant header.

ana: where do I look for the 429s? grafana alert or directly in prom?

kai: check Prometheus scrape_error_total for that job and prometheus http_client 5xx/429 logs. You can also query `sum by (job,code) (increase(prometheus_remote_storage_samples_out_total[1h]))` to see drops. For logs, search Loki with `tenant=\"nimbuspay\"` and `level=~\"error|warn\"` — there were two bursts at 03:12UTC last Wed.

matt: FYI we have an embed allowlist request form — customer must sign it. I dropped the form link in the crm ticket. Once they submit we add origin and issue a short-lived embed key.

ana: thx. last piece — any recommended alert tuning so customer doesn't flood our paging on noisy kube restarts?

zola: yes — create a suppressing rule in the alertmanager route for tenant=nimbuspay for low-severity node/container restarts. Example route matcher: `tenant=\"nimbuspay\" severity!\="page\"`. Also use `for: 10m` on flapping alerts. We can set that via the per-tenant policy in the console.

kai: I can push a draft policy if you want — will include: suppress transient kube events, increase evaluation interval for container restart counts to 5m, and add a dedupe window.

ana: please do, @kai. Can you also add the quick checks for Prom remote_write health to the onboarding checklist? Would help reduce these ad-hoc asks.

kai: will do today, i'll paste the checklist entries in the ticket.

observability-bot: Reminder — NimbusPay tenant retention: metrics=30d, logs=14d, traces=7d. Contact infra-ops for extended retention.

matt: tagging @zola for follow-up on the 429 root cause — zola you said you had a hypothesis about scrape window overlap? :eyes:

zola: yep — looks like two daemonset scrape jobs were targeted at the same targets after last deploy. I'll coordinate with the infra-deployer to fix and then post back here with the diff.

ana: perfect — thanks everyone, that unblocks the customer.

matt: np. if you need me to generate the iframe snippet for their portal devs I can do that and include CSP header examples.

ana: please, that would help.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from matt, :white_check_mark: from kai)
